purpose: Pure extraction of current Q2 development execution evidence. No policy or target is selected, fitted, simulated, or adopted.

cohort.scope: original outer OOF five folds, 24 each

future_extension.require: Root stable notification, completed manifest and passed independent audit before explicit include flag; never inspect unselected OOF alternatives

metrics.unit: each original path once, pool 120 before order statistics; no averaging fold quantiles
metrics.CVaR90: fractional worst 10% mass, with 120 auto paths exactly worst 12 arithmetic mean
metrics.breach: MDD - .40 > 1e-12; retain count/120 and conditional auto denominator if future Review
metrics.fees: mean nominal amount per initial100 over H, never return percentage points
metrics.trade_fraction: actual positive transfers / 30 decisions, mandatory inception included
metrics.target_update_fraction: active declared-target changes after inception / 29 possible subsequent decisions; report denominator; fixed-target policies 0, not confused with drift or restores
metrics.Review: preserve original120 IDs, financial values NULL; summarize auto subset separately with explicit denominator

mapping_checks: strict/pending/price candidate_local and original232 IDs match frozen strict fold mapping
all policies share original scenario to heldout fold mapping despite different context strings
exactthird target is different from fold-specific strict Balanced target; not a pure execution ablation
equal benchmark import only equal_weight_annual; old relaxed other arms excluded
recompute pooled summaries and reconcile saved source summaries
recompute episode G/MDD/fees/trades from frozen traces; source/input before/after SHA

episode_preselection.source: pending formal annual arm, OOF C H30
episode_preselection.rule: largest saved annual MDD, tie exact equality then smallest scenario ID
episode_preselection.warning: Selection favors an annual severe episode and cannot establish typical or overall relative performance

episode_states.source: actual frozen NPZ only; no raw market read or replay
episode_states.peak: unreset running maximum of annual real wealth, including initial100
episode_states.crossing: first endpoint runningMDD > L +1e-12, sticky everbreach
episode_states.recovery: first endpoint t>tau with real wealth >= fixed running peak P_tau; no horizon/peak reset
episode_states.censoring: if not recovered by H, right censored at H-tau including zero followup; no-trigger fields NULL
episode_states.equityweights: actual year-end weights; frozen target shown separately; holdings nominal balances not share counts
episode_states.exactthird_derivations: CPI=nominal/real wealth, holdings=nominalwealth times saved endweights; initial holdings [0,0,100]; posttrade holdings=(pretrade wealth-fee)*exactthird target. Explicitly derived fields not separately stored. Restore intent follows fixed annual reference protocol; actual trades use saved flags.

customer_explanation.type: rule explanation candidate, not final report or factual individualized advice

limitations: Exploratory reused development evidence, no untouched final claim
Overlapping fold training, data-learned different policies, no pooled fixed-rule confidence certificate
Dynamic policy cannot inherit static finite-family CP certification
Annual endpoint MDD does not observe unknown intrayear prices
Training risk screen and priced gate do not guarantee OOF risk or positive unpriced growth at every trade
